summary: Iteration 37 - Channel Settings Panel Testing Complete. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working via Playwright automation.
seed_data_creation: Channel settings auto-created with defaults on first GET /api/messaging/channel-settings/{property_id}. Email enabled by default, all other channels disabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Channel Settings features working: 1) Channel Settings sidebar nav button under Guest Messaging section loads panel correctly. 2) 5 channel cards displayed: WhatsApp Business (Meta Cloud API), Telegram Bot, SMS, Email (Resend), Auto-Reply. 3) Inactive channels show only header with toggle; active ones expand to show credential fields. 4) WhatsApp card: Setup guide with links to Meta Business Suite and Meta Developers, Phone Number ID input, Access Token (SecretInput with eye toggle), Business Account ID (optional), Test Connection button. 5) Telegram card: Setup guide with @BotFather instructions, Bot Token (SecretInput), Bot Username input, Test Connection button. 6) SMS card: Provider input, API Key (SecretInput), Sender Number input. 7) Email (Resend) card: Active by default, shows 'configured via environment variables', Test Email button. 8) Auto-Reply card: Welcome Message input, Auto-Reply Message input. 9) Save Settings button saves all configuration via PUT /api/messaging/channel-settings/{property_id}. 10) Test Connection buttons call /api/messaging/send/{channel} endpoints which return sandbox responses when no credentials configured.

messaging_send_endpoints.notes: All endpoints return sandbox responses since no real credentials are configured.

automation_regression.notes: 6 automation rules still working: Pre-Arrival Welcome, Day-of-Arrival Reminder, Mid-Stay Satisfaction Check, Post-Checkout Thank You & Review, Post-Checkout WhatsApp Follow-up, Cart Abandonment Recovery
